author: Pinotechrd
name: Pinotechrd application
description: A .NET 10 API on PostgreSQL, organized as clean architecture layers or as a modular monolith: versioned minimal API endpoints, problem details errors with stable codes, a frozen OpenAPI contract, health probes, security headers, CORS, rate limiting, structured logs and OpenTelemetry, with tests. Authentication, multi-tenancy, i18n and the Vue frontend are planned and not generated yet.

architecture.description: How the business code is organized.

choices.description: One bounded context with clean architecture layers.
Modular monolith with clean architecture inside each module.

module.description: Name of the first module, used only with --architecture modular (accepted and ignored with clean). Must be a PascalCase C# identifier of ASCII letters and digits (for example Sales or SalesOrders): the template does not validate it, and a name such as Sales-Orders breaks the build. Further modules are added later with a script that a later version of the template provides.

profile.description: How the application runs. Planned: accepted, but it changes nothing yet.

choices.description: Several instances. Adds Redis and RabbitMQ.

deploy.description: Deployment files to include. Planned: accepted, but it changes nothing yet.

choices.description: Docker Compose for a single host.

iac.description: Infrastructure as code to include. Planned: accepted, but it changes nothing yet.

choices.description: Terraform for the provider given by --cloud.

cloud.description: Cloud provider for the infrastructure code. Used only with --iac terraform. Planned: accepted, but it changes nothing yet.

httpPort.description: The HTTP port of the development launch profile (src/MyApp.Api/Properties/launchSettings.json), chosen when the project is generated.
